rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Very steep narrow cul-de-sac kerb with houses 10-12 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses with pools line both sides, 10-22 m from the kerb; not secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow court on a steep hill with trees over the lane; little room to pull off.
drivers.convention: No signs and no sign of parking here beyond one car at the bend.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb, mostly from the east and south.
